issues.problem: Step 11a begins 'Tilt the pod to 45' (FST_gcap_5 is reachable only at tilt 45), but the tilt servo has been engaged since step 8 and cannot be powered: the bus splice is not made until 11a.4 and the battery goes in at step 14. The pose means back-driving an unpowered Hiwonder servo through its gear train and holding the pod at 45 while 6 screws go in; the BOM gives no method or fixture.
issues.evidence: review/cadcheck.json fasteners.rows FST_gcap_5 access.home blocked_at_mm 13.4 by PRT_launcher_body (L-key short leg blocked); BOM steps 8, 11a.1, 14
issues.fix: BOM 11a.0: remove the post cover (4 x M3 x 14), slide the tilt servo +X ~10 (12 AF key engages 6.5; existing 'tilt servo out +X' row), swing the pod to 45 on a printed 45 deg prop (~40 x 30 x 30 wedge, stl/tools/tilt45_prop.stl), do 11a, lower, re-seat the key, refit the cover; add a service row for FST_gcap_* at tilt 45 with PRT_post_R_cover removed and a prop-to-cap distances row >= 1.0. Alternative: move FST_gcap_5 from (10, 16.2) to about (-30, 16.2) so all six go in at tilt 0 (reprint the 12.6 g cap, drill one Ø2.5 pilot).

issues.problem: CAB_bus_tilt and CAB_bus_feeder share one tube to the splice top (overlap -82.5 mm3); both cross the splice top at z 100.5, 0.11 from the cap underside, and turn 90 deg onto the face 1.5 below (zero-radius bend at the heat-shrink exit). Making the splice ~60 above the turntable (11a.3-4) needs ~85 extra pan lead and ~60 per tilt/feeder lead; that service length plus the stock spare (57.9 / 93.5 / 180.4) has no stated home after the splice is seated.
issues.evidence: cad q dist CAB_bus_tilt CAB_bus_feeder -82.484; cad q dist CAB_bus_tilt/feeder PRT_groove_cap 0.112/0.120; params.BUS_HUB; review/r02_sec_y4.02_splice_top_under_groove_cap.png; cables spare
issues.fix: BUS_JCT l 25 -> 20 (z 74..94, 8.0 under the cap for an ~R4 turn); offset BUS_HUB x ±1.5 per lead so tilt and feeder lie side by side; distances rows CAB_bus_tilt/feeder > PRT_groove_cap min 0.5; BOM 11a.4: trim tilt/feeder to route + 70 and pan to route + 90 before soldering, and state where the 60 mm service loop lies (e.g. groove x 10..60, left-post channel) with a section render.
